text:
Olivia (Content): Quick sync — planning launch for a new OSS refapp (adapter + tiny benchmark) + a 30-min webinar. Goal: ~500 dev signups, 150 demo spins, WC: 2 partner mentions. Blog + community post + webinar + small benchmark narrative. Thoughts? :rocket:
Liam - DevEx: Love it. Timeline? can we ship the repo + one-click demo by Wed next week?
Samir (Growth Ops): Need inbound mapping: where do registrants and demo spins flow in HS? separate workflows for webinar vs repo downloads?
Maya (Growth): I can own PR/community seeding + partner outreach. We should prep two short hooks: "fast local inference" and "production-ready serving patterns."
Jordan P.: For webinar: 20-min demo, 10-min Q&A. Demo script should highlight the refapp, a short benchmark (latency/cost) and a migration note from hosted -> dedicated.
deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: deploy/refapp-demo v1.3 -> https://demo.redwood.local (sha: 9a1c3f)
Olivia (Content): Nice. Liam can you confirm the demo snapshot (env + seed data) so marketing screenshots look clean? Also need a one-paragraph blog blurb and 3 tweets.
Liam - DevEx: I'll freeze a demo snapshot by EOD today and add a small run command for the README:
```bash
redwood run --model redwood-v2-small --refapp refapp-adapter --port 8080
```
Samir (Growth Ops): For HS: webinar registrants -> list "refapp-webinar-2027"; demo spins -> "refapp-demo-spins" property. I'll create a workflow that tags and assigns MQLs to SDR queue. Need UTM scheme.
Maya (Growth): Suggested UTMs: utm_source=community, utm_medium=refapp, utm_campaign=refapp-launch-mar27. Also want a small partner kit (short blurb + screenshot).
Jordan P.: Benchmark narrative: show 2 curves — latency vs batch size and cost per 1k tokens using default vs quantized weights. Small table in blog + reproducible script in repo. I'll draft the benchmark text.
Olivia (Content): Can someone PR the blog skeleton (short intro, benchmark section, how-to, CTA -> repo + webinar)? I'll do the intro + CTA if someone adds the benchmark and steps.
Liam - DevEx: PR incoming in ~3 hours. I'll add a tiny script `bench/run.sh` and a Dockerfile for reproducibility.
Samir (Growth Ops): I'll set up the HS forms and registrant UTM tracking. Also we should add a simple hidden field for "demo-type" so we can route community vs partner leads.
Maya (Growth): I'll prepare the community post copy and schedule partner outreach DMs. Who's on call for follow-ups during the webinar?
Jordan P.: I'll be on the webinar and field product questions. Liam can handle infra/deploy Qs. Maya — can you moderate?
Maya (Growth): Yep, I'll moderate and capture follow-ups into a shared doc.
Olivia (Content): OK next steps: Liam — demo snapshot + PR, Jordan — benchmark draft, Samir — HS flows + UTMs, Maya — community + partner kit. Please post quick updates here by EOD. :thumbsup:
Samir (Growth Ops): Confirmed. I'll post HS links and the workflow ID here once ready.
Liam - DevEx: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/refapp-adapter/pull/42 — includes run command and bench script.
deploy-bot: vulnerability scan: 0 high, 1 medium (not related to demo).
Olivia (Content): Sweet — I'll start the blog draft and the tweet thread. Can we get two clean screenshots? Liam?
Liam - DevEx: Uploading screenshots to the marketing drive now.
Maya (Growth): I'll also set up a short landing variant for the paid channel test. Will share copy tomorrow.
Jordan P.: Deadline for everything = Tue 09:00 PT. If any blockers ping me directly.
Olivia (Content): Thanks all — short updates only in this thread please so we can track. :sparkles:
